title: Gubser--Rocha charged Einstein--Maxwell--dilaton background
summary: An owner-approved Chebyshev reproduction of the bosonic background and thermodynamic relations for the top-down-derived homogeneous equal-charge five-dimensional charged dilatonic black brane of Gubser and Rocha.

source.title: Peculiar properties of a charged dilatonic black hole in AdS_5

conventions.name: model origin
conventions.value: Top-down consistent truncation of five-dimensional maximal gauged supergravity with a type IIB lift
conventions.rationale: Classifies this entry as a numerical control rather than a representative bottom-up model.

conventions.name: bulk theory and units
conventions.value: Five bulk dimensions, metric signature (-,+,+,+,+), canonical phi = 2 sqrt(6) alpha, L = r_H = 1
conventions.rationale: Fixes the source action, scalar normalization, and the dimensionless scale used by every extraction formula.

conventions.name: couplings
conventions.value: Z(phi) = exp(sqrt(2/3) phi), V(phi) = -[8 exp(phi/sqrt(6)) + 4 exp(-2 phi/sqrt(6))]
conventions.rationale: This is the canonical-scalar form of source Eq. (1); m^2 L^2 = -4.

conventions.name: ensemble and gauge
conventions.value: Each xi fixes the boundary chemical potential Omega = sqrt(2) xi; Phi(1) = 0 and Phi(0) = -Omega
conventions.rationale: Keeps the source gauge sign and distinguishes Omega from the source black-hole parameter mu_bh.

conventions.name: radial fields
conventions.value: u = z/z_H, A = -log(z) + u^4 a, f = 1 - u^4 b, phi = u^2 p, Phi = -Omega + u^2 v
conventions.rationale: The exact-endpoint factorization fixes the boundary metric, removes forbidden lower powers, and excludes the BF-bound logarithmic scalar source.

parameters.name: reported charge ratios
parameters.description: Seven frozen source cases; xi greater than one is retained only as an analytic verification point.

parameters.name: spectral degrees
parameters.description: Three aligned Chebyshev resolutions; degree 80 supplies the reported values.

parameters.name: TRF polish evaluation cap
parameters.description: Owner-approved prospective amendment after all five affected coarse states reached SciPy success in 13 to 18 diagnostic evaluations.

parameters.name: refinement ordering floor
parameters.description: Owner-approved prospective amendment covering the frozen N = 80 exact-thermodynamic error envelope while remaining far below the unchanged magnitude tolerance.

parameters.name: instability threshold
parameters.description: Source unequal-charge instability boundary; it limits interpretation rather than removing exact verification cases.

equations.description: Conformal-gauge Einstein equation for the warp factor.
equations.source_ref: Derived from source Eq. (1) and checked against source Eq. (2).

equations.expression: f'' + 3 A' f' - exp(-2A) Z Phi'^2 = 0
equations.description: Conformal-gauge Einstein equation for the blackening function.
equations.source_ref: Derived from source Eq. (1) and checked against source Eq. (2).

equations.description: Radial Maxwell equation whose first integral is the conserved charge flux.
equations.source_ref: Derived from source Eq. (1) and checked against source Eq. (2).

equations.expression: f phi'' + (3 A' f + f') phi' - exp(2A) V_phi + exp(-2A) Z_phi Phi'^2/2 = 0
equations.description: Canonical scalar equation retained at the exact horizon for regularity.
equations.source_ref: Derived from source Eq. (1) and checked against source Eq. (2).

equations.expression: 6 A' f' + f(24 A'^2 - phi'^2) + 2 exp(2A) V + exp(-2A) Z Phi'^2 = 0
equations.description: Independent radial constraint not used as a collocation equation.

observables.name: temperature
observables.extraction: Use abs(f'(z_H))/(4 pi) at the exact horizon.

observables.name: chemical potential
observables.extraction: Use -Phi(0) after the fixed scale choice.

observables.name: entropy density
observables.extraction: Use exp(3 A(z_H))/(2 pi) after L = r_H = 1.

observables.name: energy density
observables.extraction: Extract mu_bh from the z^4 boundary coefficient of f and use 3 mu_bh/(8 pi^2).

acceptance_criteria: Source algebra and coordinate identities agree within 1e-12.
Every continuation solve reports an accepted maintained-library state with final scaled residual at most 1e-9; the amended TRF polish cap is 32 evaluations.
Four independently oversampled equations and the Einstein constraint pass 1e-7 gates.
Boundary, no-log source, horizon, and Maxwell-flux checks pass 1e-8 gates.
Spectral fields agree with the exact source family within 2e-7.
N = 60 to 80 thermodynamic changes are at most 2e-6 and improve above the owner-approved 5e-10 ordering floor.
Source thermodynamics, equation of state, derivatives, and low-temperature relation pass their frozen gates.
The neutral limit, duplicate-run determinism, strict JSON, CLI, schema, artifact, bundle, packaging, and regression checks pass.

tests.expected: Equations, exact fields, thermodynamics, limitations, and every owner-approved amended gate are reported without further threshold revision.
Three declared degrees report the amended final-change and ordering evidence.
Seven-case JSON/CSV data and a verification-only figure preserve the exact-source and instability boundaries.

claims.statement: The action, analytic homogeneous equal-charge background, and thermodynamic relations in Eqs. (1)-(6) are established in the cited Gubser--Rocha source.
The HoloForge coupled Chebyshev implementation reproduces the selected bosonic background and source Eqs. (2)-(6) within all thirteen owner-approved numerical gates.
claims.evidence: Equation, endpoint, constraint, flux, exact-field, refinement, thermodynamic, low-temperature, neutral-limit, determinism, artifact, bundle, and package checks in tests/test_gubser_rocha_emd.py and the amended result record.

limitations: This is a top-down-derived classical homogeneous equal-charge EMD background used as a numerical control; it is not a bottom-up example and does not establish empirical agreement with any material or with QCD.
The source unequal-charge mode is unstable for xi greater than one; those cases are analytic verification points, not stable phase selections.

The current program does not solve the charged-fermion Dirac system or reproduce the paper's only figure, source Figure 1; source Eq. (7) specific heats, the ten-dimensional lift, unequal-charge dynamics, and Section 6 scaling models are also outside scope.
This benchmark is not the owner's phenomenological finite-density EMD research model and uses no private Mathematica implementation or unpublished result.
The implementation and model card are AI-assisted; human approval does not erase that provenance or broaden the reproduced bosonic claim to the omitted fermion sector.
